description:
E3 Welding Process ensures the most dependable frame construction possible

Thicker titanium tubing than in the past - now varies between .9mm and 1.5mm

CNCed head tube with distinctive Eastern logo

CNCed mid bottom bracket extra wide to do away with all the unneeded spacers

Spy Seat post clamp to give a clean look and add strength to the rear triangle

Formed Chain Stays for added strength and bigger tire clearance

Box gusset behind bottom bracket to increase rear triangle strength

8mm thick CNCed dropouts with built in chain tensioners

Removable Gyro tabs

Titanium products are not part of our normal production runs. Please check back for availability.

After making the Ti Grim Reaper frame, we knew we had to make a Titanium mountain bike frame. We used the same builder for the Titanium Nighttrain using many of the same features from thicker tubing to thicker dropouts as well as being welded using the

E3 Welding Process. Proven geometry from years of rider feedback on our dirt jumpers.
